description: End of the three-command promise: on a bare folder with no config and no index, init synthesizes agsc.config.json and content/index.md whose every value is schema-valid — site.base is the http://localhost/ development placeholder that AGSC-01-19 and config.schema.json admit, build.out is www/, the index title passes the 3-120 bound and its description the 40-200 bound — so the very next command, ci, exits 0 offline. The synthesized configuration names no other prose licence and so adopts the Content Use Terms, and a reservation naming no crawler fails the build (AGSC-06-18), so init also writes site.tdm_crawlers with its starting list of six crawler tokens, which the publisher then maintains as their own (AGSC-02-94). Findings are warnings only, including AGSC-E506 telling the owner to set a real site.base before publishing. If this vector exits non-zero the three-command promise of PRD-053 is broken at step two. Expected values are derived by hand from the rule text.

reason: Withdrawn for 1.0.0 (2026-10-02). The case stated that `ci` exits 0 immediately after `init` on a bare folder, and passed only because its runner replaced `ci` by a schema check of the synthesized files. The real `ci` refuses such a folder with AGSC-E901 until the publisher adds the security contact of AGSC-06-36, as AGSC-02-92 says and AGSC-02-94 now says too. Superseded by adopt-0007 (the security contact added between the two verbs: `ci` exits 0) and adopt-0008 (nothing added: `ci` exits 1 with AGSC-E901), both run with the real verbs.
